dnssecOk: DNSSEC keys generated (written — zone not signed / not on registrar)
dnssecNotOk: DNSSEC keys not generated (notes only or tools unavailable — no false success)
clusterPartial: Not fully successful ({{status}}) — see details below
notInstalled: Required DNS software is not installed
mailZonesMissing: Email domains have no DNS zone here: {{domains}}.
emptyZonesDesc: Use “Create zone” in the list toolbar
applyZoneTitle: Write zone file and register into PowerDNS named.conf + rediscover (write ≠ dig answers)
soaDesc: SOA nameserver and $TTL when writing the zone file;
recordsListDesc: After edits, use “Write zone file” above so named’s on-disk file updates.
soaSaved: SOA saved (control plane) — “Write zone file” to apply
noZoneSelectedDesc: Pick a zone on the Zones tab
clusterDesc: After SCP of zone files, remote reload (rndc / named / bind9 / pdns)
peerHostHint: Secondary NS hostname or IP (SSH key login)
sshUserHint: Needs write to target path and reload permission
lastProbeHint: lastProbe updates after probe or push
generateKeys: Generate keys; does not go live automatically
lookupDesc: Query public resolvers; verify multi-A / CDN. Does not invent answers.
digNotInstalledHint: This tab needs the dig binary (bind9-dnsutils). That is not NXDOMAIN. Install bind9-dnsutils from the host package manager; this page does not auto-install it.
noAnswersDesc: NXDOMAIN, empty RRset, or resolve failure
lookupFailHint: Lookup failed or empty. Check name, type, and upstream resolvers.
validateDesc: Create/edit auto-validates (CNAME clashes, A/AAAA format, etc.).
createZoneNeedValid: Enter a valid zone name and IPv4 address
invalidZone: Invalid zone name. Use a real domain (e.g. example.com).
invalidIpv4: Invalid IPv4. Each octet must be 0–255.
serverIpv4Hint: Address used for template A records
serverIpv6Hint: Writes AAAA when public v6 exists; can leave empty
defaultTtlHint: Default for SOA and new records
recordModalDesc: Zone {{zone}} · write zone file after save
spfPlaceholder: e.g. v=spf1 a mx ip4:… ip6:… ~all
deleteZoneDesc: Also removes its DNS record registrations.
deleteRecordDesc: Write the zone file after removal
clusterDefaultHint: Default: push then reload DNS on peers; needs system-change rights.
generateAndSign: Generate keys and try signing zone
validateExtra: Errors block save; warns (e.g. apex CNAME) only notify.
createAfterHint: After create, review on Records tab and write the zone file to disk.
soaSavedControl: SOA saved (control plane) — write zone file to apply
soaHostmasterHint: Use dots instead of @, e.g. hostmaster.example.com.
healthDesc: Host truth: unit / port 53 / written zone files / local dig answers (written ≠ reloaded ≠
healthHint: If dig is refused, fix PowerDNS, open port 53, then write zones.
lookupServerHint: 127.0.0.1 = local auth; public IP tests external; empty = system resolver
healNeedInstall: PowerDNS is not installed — install it on the Software tab first
applyNeedService: DNS service is not running — start or install it before apply
startBindHint: If start returns to stopped, port 53 is often held by systemd-resolved. Use Heal bind below, then start again.
deleteZoneNeedName: Delete this zone — you will type the zone name to confirm
healthHealPdnsHint: Set local-address to public IP to avoid clashing with systemd-resolved on 0
healthHealPdnsOk: PowerDNS bound to {{ip}} and start attempted
startProbeFailed: Could not re-check DNS health after start
startNotListening: PowerDNS start returned, but the unit is not answering on port 53
aboutSub: Zones first; records, cluster, and DNSSEC need a selected domain.
aboutZonesBody: Pick a zone under Zones, then manage records, cluster, and DNSSEC for that domain.
aboutHealthBody: Use Tools to probe PowerDNS, heal bind, and open port 53.
aboutStackBody: Check/update the PowerDNS package under Software.
aboutDdnsBody: The DDNS tab updates named A/AAAA records when this host’s WAN address changes. It does not replace zone CRUD. Written is not the same as public resolver truth.

ddns.honesty: A successful write is not public DNS yet. Resolver caches and registrar NS still apply. Empty or private IPs are never published.
ddns.needExecute: Provider updates need root and YSK_EXECUTE=1. Detection still runs.
ddns.updateDesc: Calls Cloudflare, nsupdate, or the local zone for each enabled record, even if the address is unchanged. Type UPDATE to confirm.
ddns.forceHint: Update now republishes even when the address is unchanged. Probe never calls a provider.
ddns.emptyDesc: Add a hostname below. Cloudflare, RFC 2136, or this host’s PowerDNS zone (managedBy=ddns).
ddns.pausedHint: Scheduled updates are off. Probe and Update now still run.
ddns.schedulerOnHint: In-process scheduler. Not crontab. Off means no automatic upsert.
ddns.zoneHint: Leave empty to use the last two labels of the hostname. Local provider should pick a zone that already exists.
ddns.zoneSelectHint: Local zones on this host. Cloudflare and RFC 2136 can use any zone name.
ddns.noLocalZones: No local zones yet. Create one on the Zones tab first if you use Local PowerDNS.
ddns.proxiedHint: Orange cloud. Leave off for VPN / WireGuard hostnames.
ddns.proxiedWarnDesc: A proxied record hides the origin IP. VPN and WireGuard hostnames should stay DNS only. Type PROXY to confirm.
ddns.cfTokenHint: Write-only. Env CF_API_TOKEN is used if set. Never shown again.
ddns.tokenConfigured: A Cloudflare token is stored. Leave blank to keep it.
ddns.tokenMissing: No Cloudflare token stored (env CF_API_TOKEN still applies).
ddns.rfcServerHint: Remote servers need a TSIG key file under the data directory. Loopback may be unsigned. The secret is never passed on argv.
ddns.rfcKeyFileHint: Relative to the DDNS data directory, or an absolute path under the data directory.
ddns.rfcKeyConfigured: A key file path is stored. Leave blank to keep it.
ddns.primaryFqdnHint: Used as a VPN endpoint hint. Does not rewrite existing peers.
ddns.updateIdentityHint: Store last public IPv4 in DDNS status for this host
ddns.vpnHint: VPN Endpoint can use a DDNS hostname (not rewritten automatically).
ddns.sslHint: Let’s Encrypt HTTP-01 needs the hostname to resolve here. Certificates are not reissued on IP change.
ddns.deleteDesc: Type {{fqdn}} to confirm. Local managedBy=ddns rows are not deleted from the zone editor.

err.requiresExecute: Needs root and YSK_EXECUTE=1 to publish.
err.rfc2136NeedKey: Remote RFC 2136 needs a TSIG key file under the data directory.
err.rfc2136KeyMissing: TSIG key file is missing or outside the data directory.
err.localNoZone: No local DNS zone for this hostname.
err.localNeedsDb: Local provider needs the control-plane database.
err.managedByClash: That name is owned by another feature (not DDNS).
err.invalidType: Type must be A or AAAA.

toolsFirewallHint: Allow or deny port 53. This does not start or stop PowerDNS.
toolsUnitHint: systemd unit pdns — start, stop, restart, reload.
installConfirmDesc: Installs pdns-server and writes the managed authoritative config. Needs root and YSK_EXECUTE=1.
installConfirmConsequence: After install and start, PowerDNS will bind port 53.
installPort53Busy: Something already listens on port 53. PowerDNS may fail to bind until that listener is stopped or healed.
installPort53BusyConsequence: Heal bind or stop the other listener before expecting answers on port 53.
